draft.emotion: hungry and looking forward to a good plate
notes: Refers mainly to cooked or prepared food; for raw food items or groceries in general, yiyecek is used.
Before a vowel suffix, the final -k softens to -ğ- (for example, akşam yemeği, 'dinner').
Identical in form to the infinitive verb yemek ('to eat').
